refresh.notes: Verified 12 numeric RCP averages and the Vermont Governor rating from official current race pages and maps. Nebraska Senate changed from Leans GOP to Toss Up on Nov 2 and now has a published RCP average; Nevada Governor also now has a published average. Latest expanded race tables are preferred over lagging indexed snippets. No Kalshi API prices were obtained (environment HTTP 403); Sabato and Cook pages returned HTTP 403. Their stored values and verification/publication dates were retained as stale, with updated attempt times. Individual-poll subset, candidates and personal history were not changed.
